license_required.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board

issuing_authority.quote: the board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination

name.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination to permit the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents

type.quote: the board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination

age_minimum.quote: he is eighteen years of age or older

degree_required.value: Graduate of an approved school or college of optometry
degree_required.quote: he has graduated from a school or college of optometry, approved by the board, maintaining a course of study of not less than two years

accrediting_body.value: Board of Registration in Optometry (approved schools)
accrediting_body.quote: graduated from a school or college of optometry, approved by the board

required.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board

exams.name: Board Examination in Optometry
exams.notes: Covers theoretic, practical and physiological optics, theoretic and practical optometry, anatomy and physiology of the eye, and use of scientific instruments.
exams.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board in theoretic, practical and physiological optics

exams.name: Diagnostic Pharmaceutical Agents Examination
exams.notes: Required for certification to use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents; includes relevant portions of the National Board of Examiners in Optometry examination.
exams.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall annually administer an examination designed to measure the qualifications necessary in order to safely utilize the optical application of the diagnostic pharmaceutical agents

exams.name: Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agents Examination
exams.notes: Required for certification to use and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents under Section 66B; includes NBEO portions.
exams.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination designed to measure the qualifications necessary to safely utilize the ophthalmic application of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents

exams.name: Expanded Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agents Examination (Section 66C authority)
exams.notes: Required for certification to use and prescribe oral/schedule III-VI agents and treat glaucoma; may be a single combined examination with prior exams.
exams.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination to permit the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as authorized in section 66C

interval_years.quote: Every registered optometrist shall, annually, before February first, pay to the board a license fee

required.quote: every optometrist registered under the provisions of this chapter shall, as a condition of continuation of his registration, present to the board, on or before February first in each year...evidence satisfactory to the board that in the preceding year he attended an educational conference or pursued an educational program

period_years.quote: present to the board, on or before February first in each year...evidence satisfactory to the board that in the preceding year he attended an educational conference or pursued an educational program

value: 3 hours specific to glaucoma (for Section 68C licensees)
topical_requirements.quote: an optometrist licensed under this section shall submit to the board of registration in optometry evidence attesting to the completion of 3 hours of continuing education specific to glaucoma

available.quote: Any person who shall present to the board a certified copy or certificate of registration or license which was issued to him after examination by a board of registration in optometry in any other state, where the requirements for registration are in the opinion of the board equivalent to those of this commonwealth, may be registered and given a certificate of registration in this commonwealth without a written examination

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a certificate from another state with equivalent requirements, that state must grant reciprocity to MA holders, the applicant must not have previously failed the MA examination, must have practiced optometry continuously for at least 3 years, and must intend to reside and practice in MA.
requirements.quote: provided, that such state accords a like privilege to holders of certificates of registration issued in this commonwealth, and that the applicant has not previously failed to pass the examination required in this commonwealth, and that he has been engaged in the reputable practice of optometry continuously for not less than three years immediately preceding his application, and that he intends to reside and practice optometry in this commonwealth

exists.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination to permit the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as authorized in section 66C

national_certification.value: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
national_certification.quote: include any portion of the annual examination prepared by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry which covers the subject matter of pharmacology

national_association.value: American Optometric Association (Accreditation Council on Optometric Education)
national_association.quote: a postgraduate residency program approved by the Accreditation Council on Optometric Education of the American Optometric Association

regulatory_model.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board

credential_type.quote: shall have been registered and shall have received a certificate of registration

is_mandatory.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board

title_protection.quote: Whoever, not being lawfully authorized to practice optometry, practices optometry, or holds himself out as a practitioner of, or as being able to practice, optometry

scope_protection.quote: Whoever, not being lawfully authorized to practice optometry, practices optometry...shall...be punished

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in making application or taking an examination for registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may refuse to grant a certificate of registration to any applicant found guilty of fraud in making application or taking an examination for registration.
The board may revoke or suspend any certificate of registration for unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in practice or in advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in practice or in advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual drunkenness for six months immediately before the charges are made
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for habitual drunkenness for six months immediately before the charges are made

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule or regulation made under section sixty-seven
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or for violation of any rule or regulation made under section sixty-seven

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision

methods_authorized.quote: by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision

drug_authority.value: Topical diagnostic pharmaceutical agents; topical therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (schedule VI) for certified optometrists; oral and schedule III-VI therapeutic agents for Section 68C-certified optometrists treating glaucoma and ocular abnormalities; no controlled substances above schedule VI without 68C certification; no opioids; no injection; no systemic disease treatment.
drug_authority.quote: use and prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as defined in section 66B that are used in the practice of optometry, including those placed in schedules III, IV, V and VI pursuant to section 2 of said chapter 94C, for the purpose of diagnosing, preventing, correcting, managing or treating glaucoma and other ocular abnormalities

surgery_prohibited.quote: a registered optometrist shall not use or prescribe: (A) therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for the treatment of systemic diseases; (B) invasive surgical procedures

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes

minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: for the purpose of diagnosing, preventing, correcting, managing or treating glaucoma and other ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: cardiopulmonary resuscitation, including treatment of anaphylaxis: four hours

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids

value: Controlled substances above schedule VI prohibited without Section 68C certification
Opioid substances or drug products are prohibited in all cases
Injection by any route is prohibited
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: a registered optometrist shall not use or prescribe...an opioid substance or drug product

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: use and prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as defined in section 66B

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: duly certified in accordance with the provisions of section 68B and duly registered to issue written prescriptions in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (h) of section 7 of chapter 94C may, for the purpose of preventing, correcting, managing or treating ocular diseases or abnormalities, utilize and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents

dea_registration_required.quote: duly registered to issue written prescriptions in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (h) of section 7 of chapter 94C

value: Certified for expanded therapeutic pharmaceutical agents including oral and schedules III-VI (Section 66C/68C)
tiered_license_types.quote: Any registered optometrist, qualified by examination for practice under the provisions of section sixty-eight subsequent to January first, nineteen hundred and eighty-four or duly certified in accordance with the provisions of section sixty-eight A may for the purpose of conducting an examination of the eye

value: Certificate of qualification for diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (Section 68A)
Certificate of qualification for therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (Section 68B)
Certificate of qualification for expanded therapeutic pharmaceutical agents including oral agents and schedules III-VI (Section 68C)
specialty_certification_types.quote: The board shall transmit to all successful applicants a certificate of qualification for the practice of optometry in accordance with the provisions of section sixty-six A.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: each applicant shall furnish to the board satisfactory evidence of the completion of a qualifying course of study relating to the topical application to the eye of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents...said course of study shall require a combined total of at least ninety-five hours of study

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: each such applicant shall furnish to the board evidence of the satisfactory completion of 90 hours of didactic instruction and 30 hours of supervised clinical education relating to the use of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents

referral_to_physician_required.quote: the patient shall be referred to a licensed physician, unless such condition has been previously evaluated by a physician or unless the optometrist reports in writing that such referral is not warranted

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: If an optometrist diagnoses a patient with congenital glaucoma or if, during the course of examining, managing or treating a patient with glaucoma, the optometrist determines that surgical treatment is indicated, the optometrist shall refer the patient to a qualified health care provider for treatment.
